facts.value: The BA in International Business will provide you with a distinctive and challenging undergraduate experience, structured around a broad and flexible curriculum with subject choices to understand business decisions in a globalized world influenced by political, social and legal issues.
Students spend years 1, 2 and 4 in UL. International study and work placements in Year 3 are a core part of the programme.
This international experience will allow you to attend university in Europe, the US, Latin America, Africa, Asia or Australia.
